pipeline.asset: VNS Therapy System (SenTiva / SenTiva Duo, Model 1000 / 1000-D pulse generators)
pipeline.modality: Implantable active medical device — vagus nerve neurostimulation

indications.indication: Difficult-to-Treat Depression (DTD) / Treatment-Resistant Depression (TRD) — adjunctive therapy
indications.highest_phase: P3-equivalent (CMS-mandated CED pivotal RCT for an approved device; classified Phase=NA in ctgov but functionally pivotal)
indications.trial_design: Prospective, multi-center, randomized, controlled, blinded study of VNS Therapy System as adjunctive therapy versus a no-stimulation control in subjects with treatment-resistant depression; up to 1,000 patients across up to 100 U.S. sites; unipolar and bipolar cohorts.
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING (bipolar cohort ongoing; unipolar cohort enrollment completed 2023; preliminary unipolar primary endpoint not met in 2024 with positive secondary endpoints; LivaNova initiated CMS reconsideration process June 2025)
key_milestones: 2019 — CMS accepts RECOVER protocol; first patient enrolled
2024 — Unipolar primary endpoint missed; significant gains on secondary QoL/function endpoints
Jun 2025 — Process initiated with CMS to reconsider National Coverage Determination for unipolar TRD

pipeline.modality: Implantable active medical device — targeted hypoglossal nerve stimulation (six-electrode)

indications.highest_phase: P3-equivalent (FDA IDE pivotal trial for PMA; Phase=NA in ctgov but pivotal)
indications.trial_design: Prospective, multi-center, randomized IDE pivotal trial of targeted hypoglossal nerve stimulation with the aura6000 System for the treatment of obstructive sleep apnea.
indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING (primary endpoints for efficacy and safety met in 2024; PolySync advanced titration algorithm announced November 2025; PMA submission expected to follow)
key_milestones: 2021 — FDA approval to proceed with IDE
2024 — OSPREY met primary endpoints for efficacy and safety
Nov 2025 — Launch of PolySync advanced titration algorithm leveraging the six-electrode design

commercial_product.neuromodulation: VNS Therapy System for drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE) — approved in U.S. for patients aged 4+ with partial/focal-onset seizures; models include Model 103 (Demipulse), Model 106 (AspireSR), Model 1000 (SenTiva), Model 1000-D (SenTiva Duo). VNS for depression has been FDA-approved since 2005 but not broadly reimbursed pending RECOVER outcomes.
commercial_product.cardiopulmonary: Essenz Perfusion System (next-gen heart-lung machine), Inspire oxygenators, autotransfusion systems, perfusion tubing, cannulae.
